scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/prns_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir smoke/pkg
scripts.build:package:wasm: cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/prns_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir smoke/pkg
scripts.build:browser: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:smoke
scripts.build:playground: npm run build:playground:wasm && npm run build:playground:ts
scripts.build:playground:wasm: cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/prns_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir target/browser-playground/pkg
